notes.title: Going free
notes.content: With the recent Unity Runtime Fee being announced it will affect this title, it will be made free.

notes.title: Update incoming.
notes.content: Update incoming, features include more controls over mouse sensitivity, camera FOV, help menu size. Thanks, hope you enjoy the additions.

notes.title: Quick intro
notes.content:
[b]Do you like to see explosions, you'll see many here, large or small:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35153802/4a7a9df613b5ea94b39e501b6f0aa88018eaa9a7.gif[/img]

[b]Cycle through many weapons with mouse scroll-wheel, how about a grenade:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35153802/a699f07d3f2a17e7717b57f111b427b070c44397.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35153802/235eee05e78ea17860f44ff57b303105f66fefbc.gif[/img]
.....

[b]Get multiple upgrades, for bigger and more destruction:[/b]
